title: Waikiki Turtle Snorkeling Tour with Complimentary Trolley Ride
includes: Waikiki Turtle Trolley Transportation (Round Trip from Waikiki Hotels)
Family Friendly Tour - Great for All Swim Levels
Opportunities to Spot Hawaiian Spinner Dolphins & Humpback Whales
Views of Diamond Head & Waikiki Shoreline from the Water
Snorkeling at Turtle Canyon - Safe, Beginner-friendly Experience
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Shoes are not allowed on the boat for safety. Storage is provided onboard. Clean reef shoes and grip socks are permitted.
Please wear your swimsuit in advance, bring a beach towel, sunglasses, a hat, and a light jacket, and avoid bringing valuables.
Please use reef-safe sunscreen (Available for purchase during the tour)
Tours may change/cancel due to unexpected weather or other circumstances.
The tour will still operate in mild weather conditions. We will contact you if any rescheduling is necessary.
Our snack do not accommodate allergies or pre-existing medical conditions – please bring your own snack if needed.
Turtles are protected by law. Guests must observe them from a safe distance without touching or chasing.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the delight of snorkeling alongside peaceful Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles in the famous Turtle Canyon, just off Waikiki's coast. Our double-decker boat offers panoramic views of Diamond Head and Waikiki, while our Hawaiian Hula Performance adds a special cultural touch to your cruise.

Led by a certified, water safety trained crew, this tour is ideal for families, beginners, and experienced snorkelers alike. With round-trip trolley transportation, snorkeling gear included, and the chance to see dolphins or whales seasonally, this is one of Waikiki's most memorable and family-friendly snorkeling tours.
